subject: Assurance orchestration: Order Form evidence lanes & pen-test gating
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@phantomhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: PhantomHealth Legal <legal@phantomhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — assurance coordination & SOC2/pen-test windows

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this on. PhantomHealth is finalizing an order form and we want to align on the security exhibit and practical evidence cadence before we sign. High level asks:

- Confirm SOC 2 report cadence (annual plus on-demand bridge letters).
- Pen-test: acceptable windows, staging access model, and any gating language you need in the Order Form (notice period, scope limits).
- Evidence handoff: which artifacts you can provide vs. what we need to collect from our side, and duration you can retain logs/backups.

I've attached our initial security questionnaire and a short list of preferred inspection dates (June onward). Can we set a 30-minute sync for next week to walk through gaps? We prefer the week of May 10.

Attachments: [Attachment: PhantomHealth_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

Best,
Ava Collins
Head of IT Compliance
PhantomHealth
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@phantomhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — assurance coordination & SOC2/pen-test windows

Hi Ava — thanks for the doc and the heads up. I pulled together a proposed ops/playbook below so we can be specific during the sync.

Summary proposal (short):
- SOC 2: we provide an annual Type II report (covering CC1-CC7 as relevant) plus a 30-day bridge letter on request. Evidence lane: we will map each questionnaire item to an artifact owner and expected delivery SLA (internal owner: infra or eng).
- Pen-test: we accept third-party pen-tests against staging only, timeboxed to a single 5-business-day window per vendor engagement. We require a 14-calendar-day notice, an approved test plan, and an explicit statement that tests will be non-destructive.
- Staging access: ephemeral accounts + IP allowlist for the window; RW engineer will shadow (read-only session recording allowed). No production credentials or data are provided.
- Evidence cadence: weekly status update during the evidence sprint; final evidence bundle delivered within 10 business days post-window. We retain logs for 90 days by default, extendable via order form addendum.

Action items for the sync:
1) Confirm PhantomHealth's preferred assurance dates (your sheet looked like early June — please confirm specific week).
2) Legal review: Karthik/Laura, see proposed gating text below (we can redline the Order Form PDF and share).
3) Ops: Vanessa, can you confirm staging instance provisioning lead times and whether we can shorten notice to 10 days for verified customers?

Proposed Order Form gating snippet (draft):
"Penetration testing and inspection rights are limited to timeboxed engagements executed against a dedicated staging environment. Customer shall provide a test plan at least fourteen (14) calendar days in advance. Tests must be conducted in a non-destructive manner and may not access production systems or customer data. Redwood may require an assigned Redwood engineer to be present during active testing windows and may revoke access if non-compliant behavior is observed."

Attachments referenced: proposed_orderform_redline_20270425.pdf (will send redline after legal review).

Available for a 30-minute sync: Tue May 11 10:00-10:30 PT, Wed May 12 14:00-14:30 PT. Let me know what works and I will send a calendar invite.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_orderform_redline_20270425.pdf (pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@phantomhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — assurance coordination & SOC2/pen-test windows

Grace / Ava — quick clarifying questions from legal before we lock the redline:

1) Scope definition: we should explicitly list acceptable targets (e.g., staging service endpoints, sandbox datasets). Can Ops provide a short list we can include in the Order Form appendix?
2) Notice: Grace suggested 14-calendar-day notice. Can we make that "14 calendar days unless Customer is a Verified Partner, in which case 10 calendar days"? Vanessa — is that operationally safe?
3) Non-destructive: we want to allow exploit verification (proof-of-concept) but prohibit persistent exfiltration or privilege escalation that impacts other customers. I'd propose: "Proof-of-concept exploitation is permitted where evidence is captured and contained; persistent exploitation and exfiltration are prohibited."

If Ops can provide the appendix list and confirm the Verified Partner flow, I'll prepare a redline and attach to the Order Form PDF.

On quoting Grace's draft:
> "Penetration testing and inspection rights are limited to timeboxed engagements executed against a dedicated staging environment..."

I'll add the appendix pointer and a clause on Verified Partner notice reduction.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@phantomhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — assurance coordination & SOC2/pen-test windows

Thanks — I reviewed and attached a clean redline to the Order Form PDF (see link below). Key changes I made:

- Added Appendix A (Allowed Targets): list of staging hosts, test accounts, and sandbox datasets. Ops to confirm hostnames; placeholder entries included.
- Verified Partner flow: notice reduced to 10 calendar days; requires completion of Redwood partner security checklist and point-of-contact escalation info.
- Clarified exploit language: permitted to demonstrate vulnerability with short-lived proof-of-concept; no data exfiltration, no persistence, and no lateral movement outside the scoped hosts.
- Evidence delivery: final bundle within 10 business days; failure to provide agreed artifacts will put the engagement on hold until artifacts are provided.

I also included a short SOC 2 evidence appendix mapping common questionnaire items to Redwood artifacts and owners (infra logs owner: Vanessa; pen-test owner: Security Team).

Next steps:
- Vanessa: confirm Appendix A hostnames and whether Verified Partner reductions are operationally feasible.
- Ava: confirm preferred week in June for the engagement and ack the gating language — if you want changes, highlight them and we will re-redline.
- Grace/Karthik: I'll upload the redline to Drive and send a DocuSign link for the final Order Form once PhantomHealth confirms conformance.

Redline (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
